title: This Pocket AI Computer Runs 120B AI Models Without Internet
description:
The Tiiny AI Pocket Lab is a pocket AI computer that can run AI models completely offline without relying on cloud servers or an internet connection.

Unlike traditional AI tools, this device processes everything locally, making it useful for coding, writing, image generation, and file analysis while keeping your data on the device. It also supports AI models with up to 120 billion parameters, making it one of the most talked-about offline AI devices announced this year.

Would you choose an offline AI computer over cloud AI?
